retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style layout featuring a seated subject partially obscured by large, soft-focus primary color orbs and tall condensed typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist white space is the priority

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio photograph of a person in a lounge chair, layered with large, out-of-focus red and blue circular light leaks or bokeh effects that partially overlap the subject and the background. The composition is framed by a thin dark border and features vertically stacked, ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the upper quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with soft-focus foreground elements
Contrast between the sharp typography and the blurred color orbs
Diagonal reclining posture of the subject against a vertical text block
Primary color palette (red/blue) against a neutral off-white background
coreInvariants: Ultra-condensed sans-serif font with thin outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the lower right quadrant, reclining diagonally toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertically stacked text block in the upper left acts as the primary weight anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold text in the top left, down through the blue blurred orb to the subject's face, then along the line of the chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and center-left areas provide breathing room despite the large color blurs.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red and Vibrant Blue (Blurred Orbs)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blurred elements contrasts with the muted, natural tones of the photographic subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary red, primary blue, and neutral cream/grey tones.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Thin white or light blue outline around dark blue fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying sizes for hierarchy, maintaining a monolithic block look.
graphicDevices: Small logo/insignia in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Clean, tall sans-serif that fits the mid-century aesthetic.
Captures the extreme verticality seen in vintage European design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s studio photograph of a woman in a red dress reclining in a white mid-century modern lounge chair. Apply large, soft-focus red and blue circular bokeh orbs over the image, with one blue orb partially obscuring the center and a red one in the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of ultra-condensed, uppercase sans-serif text in the upper left. The text should have a blue fill and a thin white outline, stacked tightly.

verificationChecks: Text is ultra-condensed and stacked in the upper left.
Large blurred color circles overlap the subject.
Thin dark border surrounds the entire composition.
Color palette is restricted to red, blue, and cream.

adjustableVariables: Specific primary colors used for the blurs
mustRedesign: The specific brand logo in the top right
The exact Dutch wording of the title

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading
Perfectly soft, non-digital looking bokeh edges

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the outline and background blurs.
Check that the bokeh effect looks like a lens artifact rather than a digital brush.
Verify the furniture style is period-accurate to the 1960s.
Confirm the thin outer border is present and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Studio Photo + [Subject] + [Furniture] + Large Primary Bokeh Orbs + Ultra-Condensed Outlined Typography in Upper Left.
